Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen (other, Wikidata Q355485), died 1885; Jørgen Engebretsen Moe (other, Wikidata Q470002), died 1882; George Webbe Dasent (translator, Wikidata Q3101512), died 1896. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Asbjørnsen, Peter Christen, 1812-1885 [Compiler]; Moe, Jørgen Engebretsen, 1813-1882 [Compiler]; Dasent, George Webbe, Sir, 1817-1896 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A selection from the Norse tales for the use of children, Edinburgh, 1862, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/selectionfromnor00dase. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 90%, 99%, 75% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Peter Christen Asbjørnsen, Jørgen Engebretsen Moe, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
